instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina Solutions is a B2B buy-now-pay-later provider focused on embedding flexible installment payment options into wholesale and marketplace checkouts. They serve 200 merchant partners and over 8,000 business buyers, primarily operating in the supply chain financing space. Key innovation challenge is developing proprietary machine learning models for automated credit limit adjustments based on real-time financial health signals across diverse corporate accounts.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: Lumina Solutions relies heavily on existing legacy integrations which limit the speed at which new features can be deployed. There is significant internal resistance to transitioning from manual data handling to fully automated, predictive decision-making systems.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Credit Risk Scoring Engine (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a secondary ML model that analyzes non-traditional data streams (e.g., supply chain logistics, inventory turnover) alongside existing financial signals to create more granular and accurate credit limit adjustments.

first_actions: Data pipeline audit of existing operational data sources.
Run comparative analysis between current manual scoring and initial ML-based predictions on a controlled segment.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in default rate by 10% within six months.
milestones: Q3: Model validation and backtesting complete.
Q4: Pilot deployment to a single, mid-sized merchant cohort.

opportunities.title: Embedded Treasury & Dynamic Pricing Platform (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of just offering BNPL at checkout, build a fully integrated platform that offers merchants dynamic interest rate adjustments or bundled financing products based on predicted seasonal cash flow needs. This moves Lumina from a payment provider to an active financial partner.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional task force including tech, finance, and legal teams.
Conduct competitive deep dives into dynamic treasury solutions.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in merchant average transaction value by 15% and churn reduction of 8%.
milestones: Q2 next year: Beta launch with 10 anchor partners.

opportunities.title: Conversion-Focused UX Overhaul (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Modernize the checkout UI/UX specifically targeting merchant onboarding and payment choices, making it frictionless to use Lumina's installment options compared to competitor offerings. This is a low-cost way to defend against experience-focused rivals.

first_actions: Hire a dedicated UX designer focused solely on the B2B checkout flow.
Conduct user testing with 50 active merchant users.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in successful BNPL transactions by 20%.
milestones: Q3: Full A/B testing implementation across the primary platform.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal review of internal documentation and process mapping to identify cultural blockers for data science integration.
Finalize the scope and resource requirements for the Radical 'Embedded Treasury' platform, securing executive buy-in for the necessary budget allocation.
Implement a structured sprint cadence framework to bridge the gap between informal innovation and necessary execution velocity.

key_weaknesses: Lack of integrated core systems (ERP/CRM) hinders data flow for advanced modeling.
Reliance on an informal innovation process leads to high variability in execution and resource waste.
Significant cultural resistance to adopting complex, automated decision-making models.
Limited internal technical expertise necessary for 'Bold' radical initiatives.
